enriched_activities.desc: Lies on bed. Eyes closed. Breathes deeply. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Moves arm. Bends leg. Stretches. Turns again. Pulls blanket down. Adjusts pillow again. Lies on back. Moves head. Sighs. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Opens bathroom door. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wets face. Applies face wash. Rinses face. Dries face with towel. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Wipes mouth. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk, eggs, and bread. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out bowl and plate. Cracks eggs into bowl. Beats eggs. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Pours oil into pan. Pours eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Toasts bread. Places eggs and toast on plate. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk. Places dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Selects shirt. Selects pants. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Looks in mirror. Combs hair. Applies deodorant. Picks up bag. Checks phone. Puts phone in pocket. Picks up keys. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Puts phone away. Gets off bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at workplace. Clocks in. Puts on uniform. Greets colleagues. Checks schedule. Attends morning meeting. Reviews patient charts. Visits patients. Takes vital signs. Administers medication. Updates patient records. Takes lunch break. Eats lunch. Returns to work. Attends afternoon meeting. Completes paperwork. Clocks out. Leaves workplace.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Gets off bus. Walks to house. Unlocks door. Enters house.

Walks to kitchen. Washes hands. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out meat. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out pot. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Adds water to pot. Chops vegetables. Adds vegetables to pot. Cooks dinner. Sets table. Serves dinner. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Clears table. Washes dishes.

Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Puts down remote. Picks up phone. Scrolls through phone. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Changes posture. Picks up remote again. Turns off TV.

Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Logs in. Opens browser. Navigates to website. Types search query. Clicks on link. Watches video. Scrolls through page. Types comment. Clicks submit. Watches another video. Checks email. Replies to email. Closes browser. Shuts down laptop.
Picks up book. Opens book to page. Reads. Turns page. Reads. Adjusts lamp. Continues reading. Turns page. Reads. Closes book. Puts book down. Stretches. Yawns. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene, showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Undresses. Steps into shower. Turns on water. Wets body. Applies soap. Scrubs body. Rinses body. Turns off water. Steps out of shower. Dries with towel. Wraps towel around waist. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Wipes mouth. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Lies on bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Breathes deeply. Turns to right side. Moves arm. Bends leg. Stretches. Turns again. Pulls blanket down. Adjusts pillow again. Lies on back. Remains still. Continues sleeping.
